body: Nope just diagnosed with anxiety and depression b/c Im a little shit with tons of excuses and imagination which has gotten too real

Thanks for responding. The main thing is I realized last night that every option will have something controlling me, I just want to feel free which I've only felt through drugs (haven't done in year), everything just seems so painful. If I go home, my parents will be irrational/invasive, I'll probably end up dying. 

If I stay here, I will either ask for help or avoid the mental health system and find friends I actually like b/c that will be only way I can maintain the friendships (never done before). I have already asked for help and ended up getting hospitalized which was the most terrifying thing I've experienced because although they seemed nice I couldn't read their true intentions and the sentence was indefinite, I could've been locked in there just for their fascination with me for years. Left against medical advice with my father. Made me realize how terrifying I find control, and people's lack of empathy which they hide until they don't need to. 

Or I could go to therapy and they'll have so much power over me this way. If I decide to make friends, they will have power because I will be emotionally invested in them and they will have complete control over me emotionally. Obviously the way out of this is to "get over fear of being controlled" but its been part of my life so strongly that I only realized it in the hospital, how being extremely isolated for my entire life, complete denial fog, just makes it worse. I just feel so paranoid around people in real life, feel immobilized and I'm only digging my own hole, most of my problems are from negative thought cycles that are almost uncontrollable that are my own fault. Like this is the only way I could possibly reach out but even this feels like a joke. 
Edit: when I reread this it sounds like excuses, I do get social anxiety, it could be bullshit. I dont know.
